services.name: Tarpon Fishing
services.desc: We fish the shallow back-country waters in and around Sarasota Bay, and the inshore reefs of the Gulf of Mexico The fishing charter service you choose could mean the difference between catching the big one, or telling a story about the one that got away. At C.B.’s Saltwater Outfitters, our veteran guides will do their best to make sure your stay in our Sarasota, Siesta Key area is memorable. Let us arrange an exciting trip to the shallow water backcountry to sight fish for snook, redfish, speckled trout and other species, or fishing trips to the inshore reefs of the Gulf of Mexico for giant tarpon, bonito, cobia, tripletail, jack crevalle, kingfish, Spanish mackerel.
